## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. Release plumbing — `BaseLayout` passes the release context on
   every public page; the value comes from the build's release
   context, never a page-local constant.
2. The citation block — the verbatim J3 §8.2 cite sentence + the
   release id beside the as-of pair (DR-C3-14) + the conditional
   wording per the immutability render rule.
3. The honest interim sentence — verbatim J3 §8.2 wording until
   `/s/<pub>/` exists (TX-13b).
4. `withBase()` on all new internal links — the containment count
   may only shrink.
5. Tests — missing release context fails the render; the phrase
   over a non-immutable URL fails; the interim sentence renders
   where no snapshot exists; every block link is `withBase()`-built.
6. Requirement stamps in the PR body — `SIG-TRANSP-023` (the
   citation half) + the five findings.

## Phase 2 — implementation notes

**The render model** (`web/src/lib/citation.ts`,
`citation.ts:97–256`): `ReleaseContext {publicationId, label,
recordPath}`; `citationBlock` derives `mode ∈ {unreleased, interim,
immutable}` — `undefined` release throws (the F-399 shape fails
loud, AC "missing release context fails its render test"); `null`
is the honest fixtures/development state. The immutability
predicate `isImmutableReleasePath` matches only
`/^\/[sr]\/p-[0-9a-f]{64}\//` — a real `/s/<pub>/` or `/r/<pub>/`
namespace; anything else (latest-view routes, half-formed
namespaces, selector URLs, `/releases/` pages) renders interim and
never carries `REPRODUCIBLE_PHRASE`. The cite sentence is the J3
§8.2 shape verbatim — `Cite: <title>, SIG release <pub-short>
(data as of <w>, belief <b>, ruleset <r>)` plus `, <url>` only when
immutable; `interimCitationSentence` returns the J3 interim wording
verbatim; `publicationShort` is the same 10-char slice
`release-stamp.ts` prints (one abbreviation convention).

**The wiring** (`BaseLayout.astro`): `citeRelease` derives
`{publicationId, label, recordPath}` from `getReleaseStamp()` — the
build's validated release context, never a page-local constant —
and `recordPath` defaults to `withBase(path)`. The default is the
design's honest bridge: under the root base the page's own path is
mutable → the interim sentence; when TX-13b configures
`base=/s/<pub>/` the SAME call yields an immutable snapshot path
and the wording flips with zero template edits. Pages that back a
released record pass their record path — the dossier passes
`withBase(r/<pub>/c/<comp>/jurisdiction/<slug>/)`. `Citation`'s
`release` prop is now **required** (`ReleaseContext | null`), so a
template that omits it fails `astro check` too.

**The print surface** (F-101, `print.astro`): the print footer's
cite line renders the SAME `citationBlock` contract — the cite
sentence, the conditional phrase/interim sentence, and
`Licence: CC-BY-4.0` (`DOSSIER_LICENCE_ID`, the one constant the
JSON twin's `licence` block and the print line share).

**Fixture honesty:** `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=fixtures` binds no release →
`stamp` is `null` → `unreleased` mode renders the legacy
as-of/ruleset link plainly labelled — the development state names
no release and fabricates none.

## Deviations / notes

- The J3 §8.2 signature reads `release={publicationId, recordPath}`; the implementation adds `label` (the `sig-YYYY-MM-DD.N` data release id) to the context — required by the verbatim interim sentence `<data release id>` and DR-C3-14, sourced from the same `getReleaseStamp()` doc (never a second provenance). Additive, inside the contract's "release context" wording.
- `release` is a **required** prop on `Citation` (type-level fail-closed in addition to the runtime guard): the contract's "passes release on every page" reads as never-optional, and the lone render site is `BaseLayout`.
- Generic pages' `recordPath` defaults to `withBase(path)` rather than inventing a record route — a non-record page has no `/r/` record, and its immutable copy is the TX-13b snapshot of itself; the default flips wording automatically once `base` is configured. Recorded as the honest answer to the open question in the sweep; no DEFERRALS row needed (the mechanism is TX-13b's recorded dep).
- `make ci-local` — **locally-green (not run: Docker e2e legs)** — the composed-stack + DB legs need a Docker daemon; `make check` serial + the full web gate + an export-mode staging render all ran green (base-only reds recorded above). CI's own legs are the head-bound read below.
- CI config changed: **no**.
